text:
A sound wave travels at 330m/s. The distance between the centre of a compression and the
centre of the nearest rarefaction in the sound wave is 2.5cm.
What is the frequency of the sound wave?
A
66Hz
B
130Hz
C
6600Hz
D
13000Hz
subject: Physics
